response.overview: As children, we all had something that once felt like the most precious thing in the world. For the protagonist, it was a toy that was always by their side. Yet now, having grown up, they find themselves no longer cherishing that toy as they once did.  “Why do we eventually forget the toys that once meant the most to us?”  Through the documentary, we explore how the things we hold dear change as we grow. In the place once occupied by a beloved toy, other precious things have taken its place—friends, family, relationships, and memories.
response.title: Beware of Loss
